Hard things, made simple

Who I am

I build software that makes hard things simple

Resolved Logic is a one-person development studio on the Central Coast. I work with organisations (charities, event operators, industrial businesses, trade services) that have grown faster than their systems. The result is always the same: data in the wrong place, time wasted on manual work, and decisions made blind.

I come in, map the mess, and build the solution: a custom, purpose-built system that fits exactly how your organisation operates.

Working solo is a choice. Every project gets my full attention, and every line of code is written knowing someone will rely on it every single day.

Process

From brief to delivered

01TANGLED

Understand

I start with deep discovery: mapping your current workflows, data sources, pain points and goals. I ask the uncomfortable questions so the solution fits the problem, not a guess at it.

02MAPPED

Structure

Before any code is written, I design the logical architecture: data models, user flows, access controls and integration points. You see and approve the blueprint before I build it.

03RESOLVED

Build & Deliver

I build in focused sprints with regular check-ins. No black boxes. When I deliver, I don't disappear: I document, train and support until your team is fully confident and self-sufficient.

What I hold to

Four rules I don't bend

Clarity first

I don't start building until I understand the problem completely. Most of the work happens before a single line of code is written.

No fluff

I build exactly what solves the problem. Features that don't serve a clear purpose don't get built. Complexity is the enemy.

Long-term thinking

Every decision is made with future maintainability in mind. Systems I build today should still make sense in five years.

Human-centred

Technical excellence means nothing if the people using the system find it confusing or frustrating. Usability is non-negotiable.

Capabilities

What I build

I work across the full stack, from database architecture to front-end interface to automated integrations. If it involves turning messy data or manual processes into structured, reliable software, I can build it.

Custom Web ApplicationsDjango, Python and modern front-end. Purpose-built systems that do exactly what your organisation needs, nothing more.
CRM & Compliance SystemsCentralised data management for organisations with complex compliance requirements, audit-ready by design.
Registration & Event PortalsHigh-availability registration systems with QR check-in, real-time dashboards and automated communications.
Information ArchitectureStructured content hierarchies and navigation systems that help users find complex information quickly and confidently.
Automation & OCR PipelinesPython automation that digitises physical records, reconciles multi-platform data and eliminates manual reporting work.
API IntegrationConnecting disparate platforms (payment gateways, communication services, accounting systems) into a single coherent data layer.
Business IntelligenceDashboards and reporting systems that turn raw operational data into decisions, designed for non-technical users.
Security & InfrastructureCloudflare integration, hardened access controls, encrypted data handling and audit logging for organisations with sensitive data obligations.

Turning tangled problems into structured solutions. Strategy, clarity and precision, delivered.
